title: suite2p cells
description: suite2p's cells, from its Fall.mat or its output folder: each cell's pixels (stat ypix and xpix), the image size (ops Ly and Lx), and cells suite2p's classifier leaves out (iscell 0) classified rejected. A .npy file is a plane's stat.npy, read with the iscell.npy and ops.npy beside it (stat.npy is pickled: it is read without running anything in it, and in MATLAB without Python); a folder is a plane's, or suite2p's output folder of plane0, plane1, ..., read whole, each cell with its plane. Read as the module's ROI document (imageSize and rois of id, area, center and 0-based [row, column] pixels), so the ROIs can be viewed, curated and have their signals extracted. Read only.
